manual_review.cipher: Cipher selector three constructs the 128-bit class whose decrypt initializer uses 0x4028767c. That initializer obtains standard AES rounds/Nk, divides the round count by two, and invokes the same inverse key expansion. Ten rounds become five; CBC IV is entry offset sixty.
manual_review.integrity: Outer digest selector three uses the reflected CRC32 implementation/table. The component path hashes decoded bytes with SHA-256 and compares thirty-two bytes to entry offset twenty-eight.
manual_review.signature: The nonzero inner marker branch hashes 76+92*count bytes of inner header/directory and verifies raw signature bytes at body offset thirty-two through 0x40287a94 and 0x40014e8c. The normal supplied profile points to P-256 public coordinates at 0x7be1ce64.
manual_review.unsigned_mode: A zero first marker byte is rejected unless context+92 is nonzero; when allowed, both signature and component-SHA checks are skipped on the reviewed branch. Job 0x7bd4a254 sets context+92 when runtime byte 0x70903814 is zero. Meaning, default value and complete writer/caller behavior of that byte are unresolved; no input was sent to a camera.
manual_review.validation: Complete six-component decoding and independent signature verification are recorded separately in evidence/gm1-v11-decoded.json and evidence/gm1-directory-signature.json.

limits: Native behavior is manually interpreted, not emulated by this verifier.
An unsigned branch is established statically, but its activation and camera acceptance are untested.
No GM5 equivalence, private signing key, modified update, target execution or flash write is established.
